target_customer: Data and business teams at companies with SQL databases who want self-service analytics
problem: Business users depend on analysts to answer data questions. Brewit built role-specific BI agents on a semantic layer that write SQL and charts from natural language questions.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription with a free tier and demos

founders.name: Leo Lu
education: UC San Diego, Management Science with Data Science minor
founders.background_notes: Product manager on an internal BI platform at JP Morgan

founders.name: Mark Ding
founders.background_notes: Data scientist and engineer on Tesla's data platform team

founders.name: Sam Ding
founders.background_notes: Software engineer on internal platforms for Apple's Wireless team

technical_complexity.rationale: Text to SQL with a semantic layer, warehouse connectors and a notebook editor is standard engineering with hard accuracy problems in 2023.

defensibility.rationale: The semantic layer and saved reports could create some lock-in, but the underlying models were shared and many teams built similar tools.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Warehouse and BI vendors added natural language query features through 2023 and 2024. The YC page marks Brewit as acquired with no named buyer.

market_need_then: Companies had backlogs of analyst requests and large language models had just made natural language to SQL plausible in early 2023.

identity.visual_style: Notion-style notebook product look per the landing page
identity.voice_and_tone: Plain marketing claims such as making decisions 10x faster

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand was found. A 2021 trademark for BREWIT with a coffee cup exists but its owner is not shown, so it may be unrelated, and the name collides with coffee and brewing results.

outcome_analysis: Brewit joined YC in Winter 2023 as a four person team building a conversational BI agent. The YC page lists it as acquired but no buyer, date or price was found in any source, and directory data on funding is thin. The text to SQL space attracted funded rivals and incumbents quickly, so the exit is best read as a small outcome whose terms are not public.
notes: Round added: VCBacked lists about 500K pre-seed announced 2023-04 with Y Combinator (Extruct agrees), aggregators only, no press. Extruct also shows unattributed 125K and 2.5M entries that may belong to other companies. Sources conflict on whether Mark Ding or Sam Ding was the second co-founder; YC lists both, and a Foundation Capital bio says Leo Lu founded with his twin brothers Mark and Sam. Some directories mark Brewit acquired but no acquirer was found. Landing page footer says 2024, so liveness at the exit date is unknown. Competitor list left empty: the one dated search returned only 2026 roundups and undated profiles of Seek AI, Defog and Julius AI.
